description:
The All-Terrain Motobike
Discover limitless possibilities with the Ape Ryder Comus, engineered for thrill-seekers and explorers who crave the freedom to roam across diverse terrains. Whether you're navigating bustling city streets, cruising along the coast, or tackling rugged off-road trails, the Comus adapts effortlessly to any environment, making it the ultimate companion for every adventure.
With its durable 20” alloy frame, the Comus is designed to withstand the toughest challenges while offering maximum comfort and stability. The powerful 48V 14.5Ah battery paired with a 250W motor delivers an impressive performance, allowing you to reach a top speed of 20 MPH effortlessly. Tackle hills and uneven paths with ease, thanks to the premium alloy front fork with lock-out that provides enhanced suspension and shock absorption.
Enjoy the journey without compromise, as the Comus offers an extended range of 43-53 miles on a single charge, ensuring you can explore further and longer without worrying about battery life. The Kenda 20” x 4.5” tires are built for superior traction and control, whether on wet surfaces or loose gravel, making it easy to maintain grip and balance in any weather or road conditions.
Safety and control are at the forefront of the Comus design, featuring a robust hydraulic brake system that provides responsive stopping power and precision. The long comfort saddle is crafted for ergonomic support, making long rides a pleasure rather than a challenge. With a net weight of 104 lbs and a maximum load capacity of 265 lbs, the Comus is as sturdy as it is versatile.
No terrain is too tough, no distance too far – the Ape Ryder Comus is your key to exploring new horizons. Push the boundaries of what's possible with an e-bike that’s built for all terrains and ready for any adventure.
Comus: Ride Anywhere. Conquer Everything.
